The Business & Data Analyst will be responsible for building a single source of truth for organizational data by integrating financial and operational information across multiple business processes and systems. Converge fuses cyber insurance and technology to provide businesses with clear, confident cyber protection. Deploying a proprietary data ecosystem underpinned by expert underwriting, it provides risk solutions that deliver high value strategies with improved outcomes. Our team is composed of top-tier professionals across underwriting, technology, and claims who share a passion for driving the future of cyber risk management.

Position Overview

The Customer Success / Carrier Relationship Manager will own strategic carrier-partner relationships to ensure successful onboarding, engagement, platform adoption, and operational execution. This role will serve as the primary point of contact between Converge and carrier stakeholders including underwriting, actuarial, claims, engineering, and distribution teams, ensuring seamless communication, coordination, and issue resolution.

This individual will play a critical role in supporting partner integration, training, and expansion initiatives, and will help drive platform growth across current and future carrier relationships as Converge scales globally.

Key Responsibilities

Carrier & Partner Relationship Ownership

• Serve as the primary relationship manager for our current and future carrier-partners, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic liaison.

• Understand carrier-partner needs, challenges, and integration requirements, ensuring alignment across product, underwriting, engineering, and operations.

• Ensure carrier-partner satisfaction and promote long-term engagement and expansion opportunities.

• Facilitate communication and integration activity with external broker and technology partners.

Project & Execution Support

• Manage meeting schedules, workstream alignment, and milestone tracking for carrier-partner onboarding and expansion, and keep requests aligned with agreed commitments.

• Support data, reporting, and analytics needs for carrier performance, program metrics, and capacity planning.

• Assist in discussions and readiness for new product launches and international expansion.

Strategic Impact & Growth

• Provide feedback to product and engineering teams on platform improvements and market needs.

title: Supply Chain Manager (BBS877)
description:
We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager to own end-to-end procurement and logistics for a fast-growing organic consumer goods brand selling direct-to-consumer, on Amazon, and through major retail chains across Australia and the United States. You will turn sales forecasts into purchasing plans, raise and track purchase orders, negotiate directly with overseas factories, manage inbound freight and customs, and keep inventory records accurate and current across every 3PL and market.
This is a hands-on role. You raise the POs yourself, build your own stock and landed-cost models, chase delays before they become stock-outs, and own the numbers behind every decision. The company is scaling fast and every unit made, shipped, and sold runs through this function. If you have 4 or more years of supply chain and procurement experience in consumer goods, have negotiated directly with overseas factories, understand international freight and import compliance, and are comfortable owning a supply chain function without a large team around you, this role is a strong fit.
Why You'll Want to Join

• You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)

•
Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy

• Observance of Holidays per company guidelines

•
100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive

• This role requires availability during Australian business hours

• Own a critical function at a growing consumer brand with placement in major retail chains and a fast-expanding DTC and Amazon presence

• High-ownership supply chain role where your work shows up directly on the shelf and in the numbers

What You'll Work On
Demand and Supply Planning

• Update purchasing plans for Australia and the US from the latest sales forecast, monthly or as demand shifts

• Assess stock on hand and on order against forecast by SKU, channel, and market; flag shortfalls and overstock early

• Set and maintain reorder points, safety stock, and weeks-of-cover targets

Procurement and Purchase Orders

• Raise, issue, and track purchase orders with factories and suppliers

• Keep Cin7 up to date and accurate on inventory, POs, receipts, and landed COGS by SKU

• Reconcile inventory and landed COGS with Finance via Xero so stock values and margins are correct

• Manage packaging, labels, and component supply so finished-goods production is never held up

Supplier and Factory Management

• Negotiate pricing, MOQs, payment terms, and lead times directly with contract manufacturers and factories

• Build and maintain landed-cost models by SKU and find savings in unit cost, freight, and duty

• Manage production timelines from PO to ex-factory and chase delays before they become stock-outs

• Work with suppliers on quality standards, specs, and pre-shipment checks

• Source and qualify alternative suppliers to reduce single-source risk

Inbound Logistics and Import

• Book and manage inbound sea and air freight from China and other overseas suppliers to AU and US warehouses

• Own customs clearance, duties, and import documentation in both markets

• Coordinate inbound receiving with 3PLs and check receipts against POs

• Track sailings and chase delays proactively

Reporting and Financial Visibility

• Report to Finance on inventory spend including committed POs, deposits and balances due, freight and duty, against budget

• Report weekly on stock position, open POs, inbound shipments, and risks

• Track supply chain KPIs, landed cost, and feed accurate inventory and cash-out timing into the cash flow forecast

What You Bring

• 4 or more years of experience in supply chain, procurement, or inventory planning in a consumer goods environment

• Hands-on experience raising purchase orders and building purchasing plans from a sales forecast

• Proven track record negotiating price and terms directly with overseas factories or contract manufacturers

• Working knowledge of international freight, Incoterms, customs, and import compliance

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Product Support Engineering exists to maximise the operational availability of the Dive-XL fleet. We sit between the teams in the field who operate and sustain the system alongside our customers, and the engineering teams that design it. When something unexpected happens - at sea, at a maintenance facility, in the middle of the night - we are the engineering team that answers, works out what happened, and decides how to proceed. The other part of the job is making sure it does not happen twice. We drive reliability and supportability improvements into the system, and keep the fleet's configuration and documentation current as it evolves. Between us we cover every engineering discipline - software, electrical, mechanical, systems.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for Product Support Engineers to join the Dive-XL team, supporting the teams operating and maintaining Anduril's Extra Large Autonomous Undersea Vehicles. You will be will support the operational fleet on a rotating roster that extends out-of-hours, providing anything from immediate technical guidance to formal root cause analysis. Each request means assessing severity, scoping the work and doing the investigation. From there you'll direct the engineering change, maintenance activity, workaround or documentation fix that resolves it, and own its rollout across every affected vehicle. You will also work to reduce support demand through sparing strategy, reliability and supportability improvements, better diagnostics and tooling, and supportability requirements fed into new variants during design. You will need genuine depth in an engineering discipline, enough breadth to triage across the others, and the judgement to make a call on limited data.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Provide on-call engineering support to the teams operating and maintaining fielded AUVs, including outside business hours on a rotating roster

• Establish what happened from logs, telemetry, configuration and maintenance history, bound the issue to a subsystem and failure mode and define workarounds that restore capability

• Plan and lead root cause investigations to a defensible conclusion - systemic or isolated, and whether design, production, maintenance or operation induced

• Chair Material Review Board dispositions and manage fleet-wide system limitations, including whether to operate in a degraded state

• Turn fleet data into engineering recommendations and requirements, and drive those changes through the design teams

• Build the monitoring, alerting and diagnostic tooling that surfaces problems before the field reports them, and the run books and knowledge base that shorten every response

• Author and distribute service bulletins, and track incorporation across the fleet to completion

• Create or approve operations, troubleshooting, incident response and maintenance publications

• Govern the as-maintained configuration and SBOM

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• A genuine interest and 5+ years of professional experience in software, electrical, mechanical, mechatronic or systems engineering on complex systems

• Demonstrated ability to independently root cause difficult, ambiguous faults from limited or conflicting data

• Hands-on experience with real hardware in an operation

title: Remote Billing Specialist
description:
Overview
Build Your Career at The Nest Schools
At The Nest Schools , we create meaningful learning experiences that help children grow, explore, and build a strong foundation for the future.
Behind every great classroom is a team that keeps our schools running smoothly. We are seeking a detail-oriented, family-focused Billing Specialist who takes pride in accuracy and understands that a clear, correct tuition statement is part of the experience we promise every family.
The Nest is not your average preschool company. We are a community of early childhood professionals who are valued, supported, and given opportunities to grow.
Open Position
Billing Specialist
Full-time, remote position within the Finance team. This role supports schools across the company and works closely with our School Directors and families.
This is a full-time, daytime position with regular business-hour availability required Monday through Friday. Team members are expected to maintain a consistent daily work schedule and be available during standard business hours to collaborate with schools, families, and the Finance team.
Responsibilities
What You Will Do
The Billing Specialist is responsible for the accurate and timely invoicing of tuition to our families. In this role, you will:

• Maintain complete and accurate family records in Procare, including contact information, tuition rates, schedules, and enrollment and withdrawal dates

• Invoice families monthly and weekly based on tuition rates and schedules

• Collect and post family tuition payments on a weekly or monthly basis

• Process changes to family records throughout the month, including schedule changes, added days, and withdrawal dates

• Prorate tuition and payment amounts based on changes that occur during the month

• Monitor past-due balances and follow up with families in a friendly, consistent, and professional way

• Bill and reconcile state childcare subsidy and other third-party payments, ensuring family co-pays are billed correctly

• Partner with School Directors to keep enrollment and billing information aligned and to resolve discrepancies before invoices go out

• Respond to family billing questions by phone and email with clarity, patience, and care

• Support the Finance team with tuition and accounts receivable reconciliations at month end

Competitive Pay and Career Growth
Your experience matters. This position pays $48,000 to $50,000 annually ($23.00 to $24.00 per hour), determined based on your qualifications and years of experience.
Why Team Members Choose The Nest Schools
We actively work to create a supportive and positive workplace built around our core values:
Wellness. Kindness. Innovation. Fun.
At The Nest, you will have the training, resources, and support needed to succeed in your role and continue building a rewarding career with a company that is growing.
Benefits and Perks

• Fully remote role with a supportive, connected Finance team

• Up to 50% off childcare, space permitting

• Career guidance from experienced finance and childcare professionals

• Employee Appreciation and Recognition Program

• Wellness Initiatives

• Staff events and team-building activities

• Opportunities to connect with team members across the region and company

• Clear opportunities for professional and career growth

Qualifications
Qualifications

• 1 to 3 years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, or customer service

• Excellent customer service and communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive conversations with families

• Experience with Procare or another childcare management or tuition billing platform preferred

• Previous experience in early childhood education or childcare preferred

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
MPLC provides a legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. Our business has been running for over 30 years, and we are the number one trusted partner to studios and producers for public performance licensing. We work with every major Hollywood studio and hundreds of independents, and we are a key player in the entertainment and intellectual property ecosystem.

We are on a truly exciting journey as a company. We're growing quickly, investing in our teams, and have bold plans for the future. To support that growth, we're looking for a Customer Success Executive to join our Customer Success Team.

The job in two bullet points:

• Own a portfolio of existing customers and take direct accountability for minimizing churn within that book, alongside driving renewal and expansion revenue.

• Ensure coverage completeness by confirming every customer site and location, including newly added ones, is properly covered by their license.

You will love this job if...

• You have 2-5 years of experience in customer success, account management, or licensing, with a track record of managing renewals and mitigating churn.

• You are comfortable handling commercial objections, including cost-driven pushback, in a calm and consultative way.

• You have strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

• You are comfortable working across internal teams and directly with client contacts at varying seniority levels.

• You are proficient with CRM tools.

• You are comfortable with a high volume of proactive outbound calls as a core, everyday part of the role.

• Experience with licensing, media, or intellectual property is a plus.

Let's be honest!
This is a proactive, commercially focused customer success role. You will be responsible for renewal and expansion revenue, minimizing churn, confirming coverage accuracy, handling objections, and following up on payment. Collected revenue, not simply a signed renewal, is what counts toward your book of business and your results in this role.
As a function, this team is a net revenue retention play. The goal is to move net revenue retention from 102% to 105% in Year 1, calculated as expansion plus renewal minus churn. Individual measures roll up to the team's overall net revenue retention target, not a standalone quota. If you need a bit more information...
This position runs on a structured outbound calling cadence, proactively checking in with every customer approximately 90 days ahead of their renewal date to confirm coverage, catch any new sites or locations, and resolve compliance questions well before renewal.

You will monitor customer usage declarations against public sources, provide compliance assurance, handle renewal objections, identify and close upsell opportunities, and take direct ownership of ensuring customer invoices are paid in full and on time. You will also coordinate with Legal and Finance on deal amendments and documentation, maintain accurate CRM records, and escalate the most complex renewal objections, compliance questions, or at-risk accounts to a senior colleague. Benefits
• Salary band: £40,000-£50,000 depending on experience.
• Remote Working
• 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays
• Private medical insurance (AXA), including dental, optical and 24/7 GP access.
• Life assurance at 3x base salary (Legal & General).
• Salary sacrifice pension with Aviva, 4% employer contribution. Originally posted on Himalayas

We are building the AI-native operating system for getting patients access to the medical technologies their doctors prescribe. Too often, even when a physician decides a patient needs a healthcare product (heart valves, cancer tests, genetic diagnostics, prosthetics, neurostimulation devices, home medical equipment, etc.), health insurance companies deny coverage, and breakthrough technologies struggle to reach the people they were built to help.

We help healthcare manufacturers fight for coverage patient-by-patient. Before LLMs, this work was too difficult to use AI technology for, and human teams were forced to cut corners to get through all of the patient cases. But now, AI can help manufacturers meet increasingly complex insurer requirements and get more patients access to care.

Paxos Health https://www.paxoshealth.com/ is looking for a hands-on Founding Implementation and Ops Lead. As our first business hire, reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the work that gets customers live on our platform and help build the operations that let a small team move fast.

You won't build the product AI workflows or software yourself, but you'll understand AI well enough to know what's possible, spot gaps, and judge whether outputs meet customer needs. The rest of your time goes to leading critical company operations.

This is a doer's role with real ownership. As we grow, you'll have opportunities to lead the operations team, build out a customer success team, or help establish our product function.

You can expect a fast-paced, intense, and dynamic working environment where everyone has strategic ownership. We are a small team where everyone works directly with the founders. - Build playbooks, templates, and automation so every customer goes live faster than the last, and bring customer insights back to the team to make our platform more configurable.

- Build AI workflows and automations to scale internal operations.

- Support sales with proposals, pipeline tracking, and implementation scoping for new deals.

- Help run patient-facing programs, including portal setup, intake automations, and patient communications.

- Support hiring, from interviews to onboarding, and manage our vendors and internal tools.

title: Sr AI Architect/Engineer
description:
An extraordinarily talented group of individuals work together every day to drive TNS' success, from both professional and personal perspectives.Come join the excellence!
Overview
Researches, designs, plans, develops and/or evaluates new, advanced network technologies by translating customer requirements or strategic business objectives into final product design. Work typically includes in-depth assessment of the customer’s networked application needs, providing network modeling and simulation testing, consulting to further clarify needs, and engineering high-speed technology network transports to deliver application functionality. Responsibilities
Why this role exists
TNS is moving from AI governance and foundations into execution. The platform building blocks are in place or underway - Microsoft 365, Copilot, Entra ID, SharePoint, and Anthropic's Claude models via AWS Bedrock. What we don't yet have is a dedicated person who can both build and operate the secure, production-grade AI platform that lets AI work safely against our data and embed with our lines of business to turn that capability into measurable value.
This role does both. You'll be the technical engine and the on-the-ground partner who makes AI a productive, trusted tool across the enterprise - and who multiplies that impact by enabling others to build, not just building yourself.
What you'll do
Your time will span two connected halves.
Build and operate the AI platform
Model platform and private hosting. Own our Claude deployment on AWS Bedrock end to end - model access and versioning, region and data-residency decisions, provisioned throughput vs. on-demand, and the private, VPC-isolated hosting posture that keeps our data inside our boundary and out of third-party training. Evaluate and manage additional models where they fit, and maintain a routing layer so applications aren't hard-wired to a single model or provider.
Harness and orchestration management. Build and maintain the application harness that sits between our users and the models: prompt and context management, tool and function calling, agent orchestration, retrieval pipelines, guardrails and content filtering, caching, and fallback behavior. Own the evaluation harness too - regression suites, quality benchmarks, and the release process that lets us upgrade models without breaking what's in production.
Data connectivity. Design and build secure, governed connections between AI systems and TNS data - Microsoft 365 and Graph, SharePoint, databases, data warehouses, APIs, and line-of-business systems. Own the retrieval architecture, indexing and freshness strategy, and the permission-trimming that ensures every user sees only what they're entitled to see, with no leakage across boundaries.
Security and access control. Architect least-privilege access across identity, network, and data layers - IAM and Entra ID, private networking, encryption and key management, secrets handling, and tenant isolation. Defend against AI-specific threats: prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool use, and over-permissioned agents. Partner with security and governance so every deployment is auditable and compliant by design, with a full audit trail of prompts, outputs, and data access.

title: Senior Software Engineer I
description:
We're the world's leading consumer healthcare platform, supporting millions of patients across the US, Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan, Spain and Canada.

We're driven by the belief that good health should last a lifetime, and that to get there we need to deliver the personalised, high quality and empathetic care that the traditional system cannot support.

You'll partner with our care teams of prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists and dietitians to support patients across preventative health, weight management and specific women's and men's health conditions.

We joined Hims & Hers so that you can do all of the above on a bigger scale, with more ambition, a stronger global brand and the resources to deliver care to patients in dozens of countries.

We're looking for people who appreciate and are excited by the enormity and uniqueness of this challenge, and want to work in the most ambitious, smart, fast moving and positive sum environment of their lives to transform how healthcare is delivered globally.

We hope that's you.

About you (Who you are)

• At least 5-8 years of experience in a similar role at other startups or software companies under your belt.

• A problem solver at heart. You’re able to work in a fluid and fast paced environment where you may not always have all the information you need

• Ability to ideate on our products. Engineering is able to influence the product direction so we’re building the right things in the right way

• Capable of engaging in considered and productive discourse with others on a regular basis, especially during technical scoping

• Adaptable, sometimes requirements change and we need to be able to move with them

• Several years in a similar role at other startups, scale-ups or software companies under your belt, using elements of our tech stack.

• A Fullstack Software Engineer, capable and willing to contribute to both frontend and backend code bases. Ideally a specialist in one

• You own what you ship and have been involved in the full product lifecycle. You have experience leading projects, from discovery, design, architecture and system design, all the way through to work breakdown, implementation and monitoring.

• Have excellent written and verbal communication skills

Why you should join Engineering at Euc

• We’re on a quest to build a robust, scalable, configurable, multi-brand platform (that’s also enjoyable to work on!) on which we can solve the world’s biggest healthcare challenges, and you can be a pivotal player in that journey.

• We have a high performance culture

• We have a high bar for talent, so you’ll get to learn from some of the best engineers in the industry

• We write as many low quality memes as we do high quality PRs

• We optimise for velocity and deploy to production hundreds of times a month. Once you merge your code, it’s in prod in minutes

• You’ll get to work with a modern tech stack that we’re always improving . If something isn’t working for us, we’ll iterate until we get it right and everyone on the team is encouraged to help refine it.

• Frontend: React, React Native + Expo, TypeScript, Apollo, Tailwind

• Backend: Node (TypeScript) and Go microservices, Federated GraphQL, gRPC, Protobufs, Pub/Sub and Postgres, hosted on GCP Kubernetes Engine (GKE)

• You’ll work on interesting engineering challenges:

• Euc has a large appetite for product development, so we have a roadmap of innovative, greenfield features to work on

• We've been running microservices smoothly in production for a few years, but there is still a lot of complex business logic in our legacy mono-repo to understand, break down, improve and port across.

• We strive for efficiency and invest heavily in internal tooling to improve developer experience

• We’ll invest in your growth, development and career

• When we introduced Go microservices we invested in upskilling the whole team in a new language

• No matter which direction you want to take your career, w

title: Professional Fee Coding Abstractor
description:
Nemours Children's Health is hiring a remote Professional Fee Abstractor . The Professional Fee Abstractor is responsible for 100% charge capture by reviewing physician documentation and properly coding all professional services performed utilizing appropriate ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, HCPCS codes and modifiers. Daily review of EPIC Charge Review Work queues is essential. Participation in physician training and education is also required. Maintaining yearly certification as a CPC, CCS-P, RHIA, or RHIT is required.
This is a remote position. Applicants must reside in one of the following states: Alabama, Colorado, Delaware, the District of Columbia, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Maryland, Missouri, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, and Virginia.
Essential Functions:
1.Ensure that charges for all applicable patient encounters of the Nemours Children’s Clinical Practice are abstracted in a timely manner. Utilization of hospital systems will be used to indicate respective patients.
2.Abstracted charges will be reported via EPIC EHR, external interfaces or other approved methods
3.Communicate in a timely manner with physicians, managers, and peers orally or in writing, regarding medical record documentation guidelines and regulations, and respond to all inquiries that concern the proper documentation of diagnostic and procedural services.
4.Maintain thorough knowledge of coding, and documentation principles. Also maintain knowledge of assigned medical specialties.
5.Attend in-services and seminars pertinent to assigned medical specialties and documentation requirements
6.Review and maintain current knowledge of changes in coding guidelines and regulations.
Qualifications:

• CPC, CCS-P, RHIA, or RHIT REQUIRED

• Medical Terminology and Anatomy and Physiology preferred

• Cardiology, Cardiothoracic Surgery, or ICU experience preferred

Work Schedule and Location

The Senior Instructional Designer / Consultant will be a core member of a dynamic team responsible for the comprehensive modernization of the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office (USPTO) training curriculum. title: Grupo QuintoAndar | Gerente Sênior de Estratégia GTM e Growth
description:
Sobre o Grupo QuintoAndar

Somos o Grupo QuintoAndar, o  maior ecossistema imobiliário da América Latina . Guiados pelo propósito de ajudar pessoas a amar o lugar onde moram , criamos tecnologias e soluções que simplificam toda a jornada da moradia, do aluguel à compra e venda.

Presentes em 6 países (Brasil, México, Argentina, Peru, Equador e Panamá) e com um hub de tecnologia em Portugal , reunimos mais de 3.100 pessoas no desafio de transformar o setor. Com o apoio de investidores globais como SoftBank, General Atlantic e Kaszek, já captamos mais de US$ 755 milhões e somos uma empresa avaliada em US$ 5,1 bilhões .

Lideramos a transformação do mercado sendo pioneiros na aplicação de Inteligência Artificial em larga escala no setor imobiliário. Nossas plataformas somam mais de 50 milhões de acessos mensais, administrando mais de 350 mil contratos de aluguel ativos e movimentando R$ 20 bilhões por ano.

Se você busca resolver problemas complexos com autonomia, tecnologia de ponta e impacto em escala massiva, pode entrar, a casa é sua.

Para saber mais sobre a nossa história, acesse: grupoquintoandar.com/pt/

 

Localização e Modelo de Trabalho

• Híbrido
Nosso time de Go-to-Market 3P | Aluguel & Vendas  atua no modelo híbrido , unindo a flexibilidade do trabalho remoto com a troca do presencial no nosso escritório em São Paulo, Vila Leopoldina - Zona Oeste, 1 semana por mês.

Sobre a Área e o Desafio

O negócio 3P (Third-Party) do QuintoAndar é uma iniciativa estratégica de crescimento focada na expansão do nosso ecossistema imobiliário por meio de parcerias com corretores em todo o Brasil.

Nossa organização de Go-to-Market (GTM) é responsável por acelerar a aquisição e ativação de parceiros em Aluguel e Vendas, combinando execução comercial, parcerias estratégicas, novos canais de aquisição e iniciativas de crescimento.

À medida que o negócio escala, nosso desafio é construir um motor de aquisição mais eficiente, previsível e orientado a dados. Isso exige a melhoria contínua da nossa proposta de valor comercial, o desenvolvimento de canais de aquisição escaláveis, a otimização de preços e incentivos, e a identificação de oportunidades para aumentar a conversão e a produtividade.

Procuramos um(a) Gerente Sênior de Estratégia GTM e Growth para ajudar a moldar esta próxima fase de crescimento.

Esta é uma função altamente estratégica e prática, com exposição direta à liderança sênior e grande autonomia sobre iniciativas de alto impacto no desempenho do negócio.

Suas Responsabilidade

1 . Estratégia Go-to-Market & Planejamento de Growth
Desenvolver e executar estratégias de GTM para acelerar a aquisição e ativação de corretores em Aluguel e Vendas.
Identificar oportunidades de crescimento por meio do dimensionamento de mercado, segmentação de corretores, definição de ICP, inteligência competitiva e priorização geográfica.
Traduzir objetivos estratégicos de negócios em planos de crescimento acionáveis, iniciativas e metas mensuráveis.
Avaliar novos canais de aquisição, modelos de parcerias e oportunidades comerciais.

2. Pricing, Proposta de Valor & Estratégia Comercial
Desenhar, avaliar e otimizar propostas de valor comercial, estruturas de preços e modelos de incentivo.
Desenvolver business cases para avaliar o impacto financeiro, competitividade e escalabilidade de novas estratégias comerciais.
Identificar oportunidades para melhorar a conversão, a eficiência de aquisição e a unit economics.
Trabalhar em parceria com Comercial, Finanças, Produto e Operações para implementar e escalar novos modelos comerciais.

3. Experimentação em Growth & Analytics
Desenhar e liderar experimentos estruturados de crescimento, desde a definição de hipóteses até a implementação, mensuração e decisões de escala.
Estabelecer métricas claras de sucesso, grupos de controle e análises de coorte para avaliar o impacto incremental no negócio.
Analisar funis de aquisição, taxas de conversão, produtividade e comportamen

title: Engineering Manager - Realtime

ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Realtime team at Supabase. Realtime lets developers send low-latency messages between clients, track and synchronize user state, and listen to database changes. Those three features are Broadcast, Presence and Postgres Changes. Broadcast also sends from the database and over HTTP, and clients can replay recent messages.

Realtime is a globally distributed Elixir cluster built on Phoenix. The team balances low latency, fair limits between projects, and the cost of running the service. Customers expect connections to stay up, so reliability matters as much as new features.

The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery and technical role. We don't expect you to write production code, but you you will lead a team of experienced engineers. We do expect you to join design discussions and help set the bar for engineering quality, testing and operations.

Team & People

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

- Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

- Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

- Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

- Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

- Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed a team that built and ran a low-latency, high-connection service. Examples are WebSockets, pub/sub, messaging, presence or streaming systems.
